name: Pork Ribs
siboNotes: Plain pork ribs are naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated in SIBO. Watch for high-FODMAP marinades or rubs containing garlic, onion, or honey.
preparationTips: Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like rosemary, thyme, or oregano
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Avoid BBQ sauces containing high fructose corn syrup or onion/garlic powder
Slow cooking methods help break down tough connective tissue
nutritionalHighlights: High in protein for muscle maintenance
Rich in B vitamins, especially B12 and niacin
Good source of zinc for immune function
